name: ap-sql-assistant
description: AP-SQL Assistant — Version 10.2. Introduces Cross-Device Schema Sync: on the Update Schema page, an administrator can link the active schema to a single real file (SharePoint, OneDrive, or a network drive) using the browser's File System Access API (Chromium-based browsers only). Every existing feature from V10.1 and earlier (description-driven query building, data-type-aware Decode, the Error Rectifier, order-independent multi-table joins, Define Relationship, and localStorage persistence) continues to work exactly as before.
